name: conflict-no-ci
about: Main moves before any CI ran on the PR, and the PR conflicts with it. GitHub runs no pull_request CI on a conflicting PR, so no checks ever come: land does not wait for them; it takes the conflict path at once, git reports a real conflict outside docs/, and the item goes back to build naming the file. Nothing is pushed or merged.

steps.text: main's own version of the feature

data.reason: ^Merge conflict with main outside docs/: feature\.txt$
